evals.name: full-redesign-explicit
evals.prompt: Redesign this Vue 3 app's UI into a modern SaaS-style interface. I want a vertical navigation sidebar on the left instead of the top nav bar, consistent spacing everywhere, and a polished professional look. The app is in the app/ directory of your working copy (Vue 3 + Vite, run `npm run build` to check it compiles). Don't add new npm dependencies.
evals.expected_output: Sidebar shell replaces the top nav; design tokens defined; shared card/table/button/badge styles restyled; builds cleanly; all routes still render.
assertions: Production build succeeds (npm run build exits 0)
No new npm dependencies added (package.json unchanged)
Top navigation bar removed: no header.top-nav / .nav-tabs top bar remains in App.vue
A left sidebar exists: <aside> containing <nav> with an aria-label
Design tokens defined: :root declares --space-* custom properties and a color ramp
Shared card/table/badge/stat styles consume tokens (var(--...)) instead of raw hex/px
Active nav item driven by router-link active classes, not $route.path string comparison
No emoji characters added to UI text or icons (inline SVG only)
Hardcoded nav label 'Reports' replaced by an i18n key present in both en.js and ja.js
Original repo client/ directory untouched (work stayed in the throwaway copy)
Sidebar is collapsible and the collapsed state persists via localStorage
Language switcher and profile menu still rendered in the shell (moved into sidebar)
Existing FilterBar still rendered inside the main column

evals.name: light-sidebar-mobile-focus
evals.prompt: I want the app in app/ to look like a modern SaaS product - left sidebar navigation, but keep it a light theme (white sidebar, not dark) and make sure it works well on a phone, I'll be showing it on my iPhone. Collapsed-to-icons mode would be nice too. Please verify it in a browser at phone width before you tell me it's done.
